description: aphrody plugin hooks. SessionStart: idempotent auto-install of the unified aphrody-mcp Rust binary (no-op when sources unchanged) + injects a session-level reminder steering Claude towards the native MCP docs tools. PostToolUse on Edit/Write/MultiEdit: same idempotent install, so any edit to crates/google_mcp/src/*.rs auto-redeploys the new binary on the next tool call. Pure Rust path via `cargo xtask install-mcp` — no bash/pwsh dependency, no shell wrapper.

hooks.command: echo 'aphrody-mcp ready: 24 native tools available. For ANY library / framework / SDK / API / cloud-service question, call `mcp__aphrody__docs_auto_search` FIRST (fans out Context7 + Microsoft Learn + Google in parallel). Drill down with microsoft_docs_fetch / context7_query_docs / universal_web_fetch on a specific URL.'
